title: Atlas of cell types and regulatory elements underlying human facial diversity
key_finding: Human embryonic facial atlas identifies 56 cell states, positional transcriptional codes and regulatory element associations with facial traits; mouse perturbations support roles of a PAX1-linked regulatory element and peripheral nerves in skeletal morphology.
runx2_value: Reference for linking mesenchymal positional identity, cell differentiation and neural interactions to facial morphology. Human GWAS evidence is not proof of RUNX2 causality.
methods: scRNA-seq, snRNA/ATAC-seq, Stereo-seq, Visium, micro-CT, Moran's I, SCENIC+, LinkPeaks, GWAS

title: Single-cell multiome characterizing intercellular communication and intracellular regulation of epithelium and mesenchymal during secondary palate development in mice
key_finding: Mouse palatal multiome analysis predicts region-specific epithelial–mesenchymal communication including WNT4–FZD2/LRP6.
runx2_value: Developmental reference for WNT receptor complexes and cell-type-specific signaling; inference requires functional validation.
methods: single-cell RNA and ATAC multiome, communication analysis

title: Sensory nerve-derived signaling coordinates oropharyngeal structural organization that supports suckling and vocalization in neonatal mice
key_finding: Sensory neuronal GDF11 regulates perimysial cells and soft-palate tissue organization through Akt–FoxO1–Thbs3.
runx2_value: Mechanistic reference for neural–mesenchymal–ECM interactions; soft palate is not maxillary bone.
methods: single-cell RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, sensory neuron-specific knockout

title: CSF1R+ macrophage and osteoclast depletion impairs neural crest proliferation and craniofacial morphogenesis
key_finding: Combined macrophage and osteoclast depletion impairs cranial neural crest proliferation and craniofacial development.
runx2_value: Reference for immune–mesenchymal regulation of proliferation; effects cannot be assigned to either depleted lineage alone.
methods: CSF1R inhibition, embryonic mouse phenotyping

title: Modeling the chondrocyte-derived osteoblasts formation process reveals its molecular signature and regulation network
key_finding: Models of chondrocyte-derived osteoblast formation identify transitional molecular programs.
runx2_value: Reference for evaluating osteochondral transitions without inferring lineage conversion solely from expression.
methods: mouse bone models, in vitro differentiation, molecular profiling

title: Targeting the Ip6k2–Runx2 axis disrupts osteoblast–osteoclast coupling to treat osteoporosis
key_finding: IP6K2 interacts with RUNX2 and supports Ctsk transcription during osteoclastogenesis.
runx2_value: Context-specific RUNX2 function outside osteoblasts; adult bone remodeling is not embryonic midface development.
methods: conditional knockout, transcriptomics, co-immunoprecipitation, rescue

title: Meis2 transcription factor regulates craniofacial osteogenesis via IGF signaling and cell adhesion
key_finding: Meis2 deficiency alters adhesion and IGF signaling in cranial mesenchyme.
runx2_value: Connect local signaling and cell adhesion to osteogenesis.
methods: Spatial and single-cell transcriptomics, conditional knockout

title: Positional programs in early murine facial development and their role in human facial shape variability
key_finding: Early mouse facial mesenchyme shows position-associated transcriptional diversity.

title: A RUNX2 reporter is expressed prior to osteochondral differentiation and models metaphyseal dysplasia with maxillary hypoplasia and brachydactyly
